title: phacelia secunda var. pinnata
intro: Phacelia secunda var. pinnata, commonly known as Pinnate Phacelia, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae) native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The plant is also believed to have therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities, which can contribute to its overall health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pinnate Phacelia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
